newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gas company TGN issues $70 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gas company TGN issues $70 mln notes.

text.p: Transportadora de Gas del Norte, one of Argentina's two gas transport companies, said Friday it has issued $70 million in negotiable bonds.

TGN told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange the issuing of a fourth $46 million series and fifth $24 million series make part of an already announced negotiable bond global program of up to $300 million.
Santander Investment Bank Limited is the underwriter.
TGN said permission will be sought for the series to be listed also in the Luxemburg Stock Exchange and Argentina's Open Electronic Market (MAE SA).

The fourth series is a five year issue at floating rate equal to 180-day LIBOR plus 100 basis points for the first and second years, 125 basis points for the third and fourth and 150 basis points for the fifth.

The fifth series is a seven year issue at floating rate equal to 180-day LIBOR plus 100 basis points for the first and second years, 125 basis points for the third and fourth, 150 basis points for the fifth and sixth and 170 for the seventh.

TGN is 70.58 percent owned by Gasinvest, a holding company formed by Canada's NOVA, Argentina's Techint and Comercial del Plata and Malaysia's state oil company Petronas. U.S. CMS owns a 25 percent of TGN and TGN's employees own the remaining 4.42 percent.
